sections.text:
Нормативный порядок и команды — `@plan/knowledge/research-P01-design.json` §4. `$P` = `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL`.
Комментарии в bash-блоках начинаются с пробела (` # …`), чтобы селекторы секций Task не принимали их за заголовки; для bash это эквивалентно.
Код ниже — готовая основа; исполнитель адаптирует только помеченное `ADAPT:`. Поля `phpSurface()` в §3.2 обязательны
по досье §4.2: properties, значения/типы constants и defaults параметров не являются местами адаптации.

sections.title: 1 `scripts/php84` (проверено 2026-09-28 на хосте)
sections.text:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
 # Runs a command with PHP 8.4 as `php` on PATH, so Composer scripts and
 # `#!/usr/bin/env php` binaries use 8.4 even when the host default is older.
 # Usage: scripts/php84 --check | scripts/php84 <command> [args...]
set -euo pipefail

root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
bin="${PHP84_BIN:-$(command -v php8.4 || true)}"

if [[ -z "$bin" || ! -x "$bin" ]]; then
    echo "php84: php8.4 binary not found (set PHP84_BIN)" >&2
    exit 1
fi

shim="$root/build/php84/bin"
mkdir -p "$shim"
ln -sf "$bin" "$shim/php"
export PATH="$shim:$PATH"

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--check" ]]; then
    version="$(php -r 'echo PHP_VERSION;')"
    if [[ "$version" != 8.4.* ]]; then
        echo "php84: expected PHP 8.4.x, got $version" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    required=(ctype curl dom fileinfo gd gmp intl bcmath mbstring openssl pcntl pcov pdo_pgsql pdo_sqlite sqlite3 tokenizer xml zip)
    missing=()
    for ext in "${required[@]}"; do
        php -r "exit(extension_loaded('$ext') ? 0 : 1);" || missing+=("$ext")
    done
    if (( ${#missing[@]} )); then
        echo "php84: MISSING: ${missing[*]}" >&2
        # Several extensions ship in one apt package (dom → xml, pdo_sqlite → sqlite3).
        declare -A packages=()
        for ext in "${missing[@]}"; do
            case "$ext" in
                dom) packages[xml]=1 ;;
                pdo_pgsql) packages[pgsql]=1 ;;
                pdo_sqlite) packages[sqlite3]=1 ;;
                *) packages[$ext]=1 ;;
            esac
        done
        echo "php84: owner action: sudo apt install $(printf 'php8.4-%s ' $(printf '%s\n' "${!packages[@]}" | sort))" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    echo "php84 OK: $version, extensions complete"
    exit 0
fi

exec "$@"
```

Эталонные выходы на хосте 2026-09-28 (до O-1):

```text
$ scripts/php84 --check
php84: MISSING: dom gd gmp intl bcmath pcov pdo_sqlite sqlite3 xml zip
php84: owner action: sudo apt install php8.4-bcmath php8.4-gd php8.4-gmp php8.4-intl php8.4-pcov php8.4-sqlite3 php8.4-xml php8.4-zip
exit 1
$ scripts/php84 bash -c 'env php -v | head -1'
PHP 8.4.26 (cli) (built: Sep 24 2026 17:15:37) (NTS)
```
`build/` игнорируется (`.gitignore:7 /build/`, проверено `git check-ignore`).

sections.title: 5.2 `scripts/phpstan-packages.sh`
sections.text:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
 # Analyses each package with its own config and baseline, then enforces the ratchet.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

status=0
for config in packages/*/phpstan.neon phpstan.neon; do
    echo "==> ${config}"
    vendor/bin/phpstan analyse -c "$config" --memory-limit=2G --no-progress || status=1
done
php scripts/quality-ceiling-guard.php || status=1
exit "$status"
```

6.3 `scripts/anti-weakening-gate.sh` — замена строк 71–76
sections.text:
```bash
 # Quality ratchet (PLAN3.D37/D40/D39): ceilings may only fall, ownership baseline may only
 # lose entries, golden baseline changes need a REBASELINE.md entry.
if git diff "$DIFF_RANGE" -- scripts/quality-ceilings.json | command grep -qE '^\+\s+"[a-z-]+": [0-9]+'; then
    python3 - "$DIFF_RANGE" <<'PY' || log_fail "quality ceiling raised (scripts/quality-ceilings.json)"
import json, subprocess, sys
rng = sys.argv[1].split('...')[0].split('..')[0]
path = 'scripts/quality-ceilings.json'
original = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', f'{rng}:{path}'], capture_output=True, text=True)
if original.returncode:
    exists = subprocess.run(['git', 'ls-tree', '--name-only', rng, '--', path], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if exists.returncode or exists.stdout.strip():
        sys.exit(1)
    introduced = subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--reverse', '--diff-filter=A', '--format=%H', f'{rng}..HEAD', '--', path], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if introduced.returncode:
        sys.exit(1)
    commits = introduced.stdout.splitlines()
    if commits:
        original = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', f'{commits[0]}:{path}'], capture_output=True, text=True)
        if original.returncode:
            sys.exit(1)
old = json.loads(original.stdout or '{}')
new = json.load(open('scripts/quality-ceilings.json'))
raised = [f'{k}.{p}' for k in new if isinstance(new[k], dict) for p, v in new[k].items() if v > old.get(k, {}).get(p, v)]
raised += [f'{k}.total' for k in new if isinstance(new[k], dict) and old and sum(new[k].values()) > sum(old.get(k, {}).values())]
sys.exit(1 if raised else 0)
PY
fi
python3 - "$DIFF_RANGE" <<'PYGUARD' || log_fail "ownership baseline gained entries (only removals allowed)"
import json, subprocess, sys
base = sys.argv[1].split('...')[0].split('..')[0]
path = 'scripts/ownership-gate-baseline.json'
old = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', f'{base}:{path}'], capture_output=True, text=True)
if old.returncode:
    # If the remote comparison base predates creation, bind the first introduced
    # baseline. Absence in that remote base must never excuse later debt growth.
    exists = subprocess.run(['git', 'ls-tree', '--name-only', base, '--', path], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if exists.returncode or exists.stdout.strip():
        sys.exit(1)
    introduced = subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--reverse', '--diff-filter=A', '--format=%H', f'{base}..HEAD', '--', path], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if introduced.returncode:
        sys.exit(1)
    commits = introduced.stdout.splitlines()
    if not commits:
        sys.exit(0)
    old = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', f'{commits[0]}:{path}'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if old.returncode:
        sys.exit(1)
new = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{path}'], capture_output=True, text=True)
if new.returncode:
    sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(1 if set(json.loads(new.stdout)['violations']) - set(json.loads(old.stdout)['violations']) else 0)
PYGUARD
if git diff --name-only "$DIFF_RANGE" -- tests/Golden/baseline | command grep -q . \
   && ! git diff "$DIFF_RANGE" -- tests/Golden/REBASELINE.md | command grep -qE '^\+\| [0-9]{4}-'; then
    log_fail "golden baseline changed without a REBASELINE.md entry"
fi
```
Первичное создание (P01): ceilings и ownership baseline — новые файлы, в `old` отсутствуют → не рост; golden baseline
создаётся вместе с первой строкой `REBASELINE.md`. ADAPT: `DIFF_RANGE` и `log_fail` — существующие в скрипте.

sections.title: 7 Dependency analyser
sections.text:
`packages/

/composer-dependency-analyser.php`: ```php addPathToScan(__DIR__.'/src', isDev: false) ->addPathToScan(__DIR__.'/tests', isDev: true) // ratchet: P07 notifications→wakeup must go through a kernel contract (PLAN3.D16) ->ignoreErrorsOnPackage('corex/wakeup', [ErrorType::SHADOW_DEPENDENCY]); // ADAPT: только при факте ``` `scripts/dependency-analyser.sh`: ```bash #!/usr/bin/env bash # Runs composer-dependency-analyser for a package inside its own standalone install, # which is what a split repository will resolve. set -euo pipefail cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" run() { local dir="$1" local result=0 if [[ "$dir" == tenancy ]]; then python3 scripts/distribution/stage-stancl-providers.py >/dev/null || result=$? fi if (( result == 0 )); then composer --working-dir="packages/$dir" update --no-interaction --no-progress --quiet || result=$? fi if [[ "$dir" == tenancy ]]; then # Staging registers both installing roots; reconcile both even after update fails. composer config --unset repositories.stancl-providers || result=$? composer --working-dir="packages/$dir" config --unset repositories.stancl-providers || result=$? fi (( result == 0 )) || return "$result" vendor/bin/composer-dependency-analyser \ --composer-json="packages/$dir/composer.json" \ --config="packages/$dir/composer-dependency-analyser.php" } if [[ "${1:-}" == "--all" ]]; then status=0 for manifest in packages/*/composer.json; do dir="$(basename "$(dirname "$manifest")")" echo "==> $dir" run "$dir" || status=1 done exit "$status" fi run "${1:?usage: dependency-analyser.sh |--all}" ``` Эталон: `No composer issues found` на пакет; итог exit 0.

```yaml manifests: name: Manifests (validate --strict, D36) runs-on: ubuntu-latest permissions: contents: read steps: - uses: actions/checkout@ # v7.0.1 with: persist-credentials: false - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@ # 2.37.2 with: php-version: '8.4' coverage: none - run: python3 scripts/manifest-check.py - run: for f in composer.json packages/*/composer.json; do composer validate --strict --no-check-lock --working-dir="$(dirname "$f")" || exit 1; done zizmor: name: Workflow security (zizmor) runs-on: ubuntu-latest permissions: contents: read steps: - uses: actions/checkout@ # v7.0.1 with: persist-credentials: false - uses: zizmorcore/zizmor-action@ # v0.6.4 with: advanced-security: false ``` Аналогично `golden` (`composer golden`), `ownership` (`php scripts/ownership-gate.php`), `dependencies` (`bash scripts/dependency-analyser.sh --all` + `composer audit --locked --working-dir=packages/

` в цикле); шаг PHPStan в `quality` → `composer analyse`. PG: `tests-pg` — `matrix.postgres: ['16', '18']`, `image: postgres:${{ matrix.postgres }}`.

sections.title: 8.3 Конфиги
sections.text:

```yaml
version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directory: /
    schedule: { interval: weekly }
    groups:
      actions: { patterns: ['*'] }
  - package-ecosystem: composer
    directories: ['/', '/packages/*']
    schedule: { interval: weekly }
    groups:
      composer: { patterns: ['*'] }
```
